approval.note: Trump job approval, net (approve minus disapprove): average of the RealClearPolling (-22.1) and Silver Bulletin (about -22.7) nets as of Oct 30-Nov 2, 2026 (-22.4, rounded to the nearest 0.5: -22.5), unchanged since Oct 29. RealClearPolling's page as opened on Nov 2 still showed the 10/9-10/25 average (38.2/60.3). Silver Bulletin's page (updated Oct 30) prints approve 37.3% and disapprove only as 'about 60 percent', so its net is approximate. FiftyPlusOne's Nov 1 average (35.4/61.6, net -26) is a check.
sources: RealClearPolling average, Nov 2 (polls 10/9-10/25 as opened): 38.2/60.3, net -22.1
Silver Bulletin average, updated Oct 30: approve 37.3%, disapprove 'about 60 percent' (net about -22.7)

specials.note: Average Democratic improvement on the 2024 presidential margin across D-vs-R special elections since January 2025. The Downballot's Oct 20, 2026 update ('Special elections show Democrats headed for a year as good as 2018, if not better') remains paywalled with no tally visible (last checked Nov 2), so the Aug 19 tally stays; MultiState's 2026-only median (+10.4 across 37 contested specials through April) is a different measure and is not used

offyear.note: 2025 governor margin minus the state's 2024 presidential margin
